test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

A sincere person creates goodwill __whenever__ he goes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'wherever'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we read the sentence, we get to know **the conjunction (whenever) does not match with the phrase (he goes).**
 
• **For examples:**
 
 
• He breaks everything **wherever**__ he goes.
 
•
